what: Ovintiv is an oil and gas producer with operations in the Permian basin, the Anadarko basin in Oklahoma, and the Montney in western Canada. It produces both oil and natural gas.
customers: Refiners, gas processors and crude buyers in North America.
money: oil-weighted production in Texas and New Mexico
moat: A multi-basin position that lets it shift capital between oil and gas depending on which is better priced, which single-basin producers cannot do.
risks: Oil and gas prices set earnings
Revenue has fallen about 15% a year over three years
Debt of about $5 billion against almost no cash
Shale wells decline quickly, so drilling must continue just to hold production
opportunities: Analysts see about 34% upside from current levels
Canadian LNG exports raise the value of its Montney gas
Multi-basin flexibility lets it direct capital to whichever commodity is stronger
watch: Well costs, production mix between oil and gas, and free cash flow.
